OrderReference.name: Order Reference
OrderReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an order, as assigned by the instructing party.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of an order. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the order as assigned by the underlying client.

DealReference.name: Deal Reference
DealReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an order execution, as assigned by a confirming party.

OrderType.name: Order Type
OrderType.definition: Specifies the category of the investment fund order.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Investment fund class to which an investment fund order execution is related.

SubAccountForHolding.name: Sub Account For Holding
SubAccountForHolding.definition: Subdivision of an account used to segregate specific holdings.

UnitsNumber.name: Units Number
UnitsNumber.definition: Number of investment fund units subscribed.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Amount of money invested in a specific financial instrument by an investor, after deduction of charges, commissions and taxes.|[Quantity * Price].

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Amount of money invested in a specific financial instrument by an investor, before deduction of charges, commissions, and taxes.|[(Quantity * Price) + (Charges + Commissions +Taxes)].

Rounding.name: Rounding
Rounding.definition: Indicates the rounding direction applied to nearest unit.

TradeDateTime.name: Trade Date Time
TradeDateTime.definition: Date and time at which a price is applied, according to the terms stated in the prospectus.

DealingPriceDetails.name: Dealing Price Details
DealingPriceDetails.definition: Price at which the order was executed.

InformativePriceDetails.name: Informative Price Details
InformativePriceDetails.definition: Other quoted price than the one at which the order was executed.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid /to be paid or received in exchange for the financial instrument in the individual order.

CashSettlementDate.name: Cash Settlement Date
CashSettlementDate.definition: Date on which cash is available.

SettlementMethod.name: Settlement Method
SettlementMethod.definition: Method by which the transaction is settled.

PartiallyExecutedIndicator.name: Partially Executed Indicator
PartiallyExecutedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the order has been partially executed, ie, the confirmed quantity does not match the ordered quantity for a given financial instrument.

BestExecution.name: Best Execution
BestExecution.definition: Specifies that the execution was subject to best execution rules as defined by MiFID.

CumDividendIndicator.name: Cum Dividend Indicator
CumDividendIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the dividend is included, ie, cum-dividend, in the executed price. When the dividend is not included, the price will be ex-dividend.

InterimProfitAmount.name: Interim Profit Amount
InterimProfitAmount.definition: Part of the price deemed as accrued income or profit rather than capital. The interim profit amount is used for tax purposes.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

IncomePreference.name: Income Preference
IncomePreference.definition: Dividend option chosen by the account owner based on the options offered in the prospectus.

LetterIntentReference.name: Letter Intent Reference
LetterIntentReference.definition: Reference of a letter of intent program, in which sales commissions are reduced based on the aggregate of a customer's actual purchase and anticipated purchases, over a specific period of time, and as agreed by the customer. A letter of intent program is mainly used in the US market.

AccumulationRightReference.name: Accumulation Right Reference
AccumulationRightReference.definition: Reference of an accumulation right program, in which sales commissions are based on a customer's present purchases of shares and the aggregate quantity previously purchased by the customer. An accumulation rights program is mainly used in the US market.

ChargeGeneralDetails.name: Charge General Details
ChargeGeneralDetails.definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

CommissionGeneralDetails.name: Commission General Details
CommissionGeneralDetails.definition: Amount of money due to a party as compensation for a service.

TaxGeneralDetails.name: Tax General Details
TaxGeneralDetails.definition: Tax related to an investment fund order.

SettlementAndCustodyDetails.name: Settlement And Custody Details
SettlementAndCustodyDetails.definition: Parameters used to execute the settlement of an investment fund order.

PhysicalDeliveryIndicator.name: Physical Delivery Indicator
PhysicalDeliveryIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is to be physically delivered.

PhysicalDeliveryDetails.name: Physical Delivery Details
PhysicalDeliveryDetails.definition: Information related to physical delivery of the securities.

RequestedSettlementCurrency.name: Requested Settlement Currency
RequestedSettlementCurrency.definition: Currency requested for settlement of cash proceeds.

RequestedNAVCurrency.name: Requested NAV Currency
RequestedNAVCurrency.definition: Currency to be used for pricing the fund. This currency must be among the set of currencies in which the price may be expressed, as stated in the prospectus.

Refund.name: Refund
Refund.definition: Return of cash that has been overpaid for a subscription.

SubscriptionInterest.name: Subscription Interest
SubscriptionInterest.definition: Interest received when a subscription amount is paid in advance and then invested by the fund.

CashSettlementDetails.name: Cash Settlement Details
CashSettlementDetails.definition: Payment transaction resulting from the investment fund order execution.

NonStandardSettlementInformation.name: Non Standard Settlement Information
NonStandardSettlementInformation.definition: Additional specific settlement information for non-regulated traded funds.

StaffClientBreakdown.name: Staff Client Breakdown
StaffClientBreakdown.definition: Breakdown of the net amount per type of order.

FinancialAdvice.name: Financial Advice
FinancialAdvice.definition: Specifies if advice has been received from an independent financial advisor.

NegotiatedTrade.name: Negotiated Trade
NegotiatedTrade.definition: Specifies whether the trade is negotiated.

LateReport.name: Late Report
LateReport.definition: Specifies whether the order execution confirmation is late.

RelatedPartyDetails.name: Related Party Details
RelatedPartyDetails.definition: Information about parties related to the transaction.

Equalisation.name: Equalisation
Equalisation.definition: Part of an investor's subscription amount that is held by the fund in order to pay incentive / performance fees at the end of the fiscal year.

PhysicalDeliveryDetailsRule.definition: If PhysicalDeliveryIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then PhysicalDeliveryDetails is not allowed. If PhysicalDeliveryIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then PhysicalDeliveryDetails must be present.

PriceDifferenceReasonRule.definition: Any occurrence of InformativePriceDetails/PriceDifferenceReason may not be present.

RequestedSettlementCurrencyRule.definition: If RequestedSettlementCurrency is present, it must be the same Currency as in SettlementAmount.
